thread:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Zeta cohort onboarding is stuck. 7 invites still pending acceptance and the SSO cert job is erroring. If this drags past next week renewals for this account could get messy. Can we triage?
aj_platform: Thanks — can you paste the error and the affected account IDs?
sam_eng: I can take the cert job, ping me the job id and I’ll attempt a manual run.
maria_cs: job id: job-2026-04-12-77. Affected orgs: zeta-co, zeta-ops, zeta-test. Error shows "certificate provisioning: upstream 502". Also two users reported they never got the invite email.
deploy-bot: Cert job job-2026-04-12-77 failed at 2026-04-12T15:02:11Z with exit code 1. Logs: "POST /kms/issue -> 502 Bad Gateway". (retry scheduled)
aj_platform: Hmm looks like KMS gateway flake in us-west-2. Sam — if you run manual provisioning you might need to re-run with --retry 3 and use KMS fallback key id=kms-fallback-01.
sam_eng: Copy. Running manual now. Will try: ```redwood cert provision --job job-2026-04-12-77 --retries 3 --fallback-key kms-fallback-01```
natalie_success: From CS side we’ll pause the onboarding emails so we don’t spam until invites are re-sent. Also proposing a short enablement session for Zeta on Thursday 10am PT to reduce churn risk. OK with everyone?
maria_cs: Yes please pause. Can you also surface a short checklist for the call — SSO, invite flow, initial prompt templates, workspace admin steps.
natalie_success: Will do — drafting and will post in the channel.
sam_eng: Manual run complete. Outcome: cert provisioned for zeta-co and zeta-ops; zeta-test hit a transient KMS timeout but retried and succeeded. Resent invites for the 7 users at 2026-04-12T15:34Z.
maria_cs: Amazing, thanks Sam :tada: — I’ll notify the customer and set the enablement session.
maria_cs: Quick note for tracking — adding renewal_risk tag to the account for 2 weeks until we get training attendance and acceptance rates >= 80%.
aj_platform: Also recommend enabling temporary prefix caching for their initial eval queries to reduce cold-start cost during the trial.
natalie_success: Posted the enablement checklist and invite calendar in the thread: https://redwood.example.com/enablement/zeta-checklist — includes a short feedback survey we'll send 48h after the session.
maria_cs: Sending customer update now. Will follow up here with acceptance numbers by 11:15 PST.
sam_eng: FYI I dropped a one-off health check run for their dedicated pool — no anomalies after the cert fix.
maria_cs: Update: 4/7 accepted so far, two pending, one bounce (bad email). Natalie is reaching out to replace that seat.
natalie_success: Reached out to the account admin and queued replacement invite. Also added a note to capture any prompting examples they use during the session for our eval team.
aj_platform: Nice. Once we have session notes, ops can recommend quantization and batching profiles based on their prompt lengths.
maria_cs: Closing the immediate blocker — thanks everyone. Please drop any follow-ups here.
